linked_module.linking: Original main PLT reads its GOT; only the imported GOT pointer is resolved. Main/SDK instructions are unchanged.
linked_module.scope: Only SDK text needed by the self-contained strcmp routine is mapped. Other SDK imports, initializers and syscalls are not executed.

scope: Actual SDK strcmp executed on every byte pair, aligned/unaligned prefixes, UTF-8, long strings. Input buffers are NUL terminated inside mapped memory.
